templates.text: Hey, I'm having a rough time. Can you call me when you're free?
Are you around tonight? I don't really want to be on my own.
Not an emergency, but could you check in on me tomorrow?

grounding.title: Name 5 things you can see.
grounding.body: Look around slowly. Say them out loud or in your head: a colour, a shape, something small.

grounding.title: Name 4 things you can feel.
grounding.body: Your feet on the floor. The fabric on your arms. The air on your face. Something in your hand.

grounding.title: Name 3 things you can hear.
grounding.body: Near or far. A hum, a voice, your own breath.

grounding.title: Name 2 things you can smell.
grounding.body: If nothing comes, think of two smells you like.

grounding.title: Name 1 thing you can taste.
grounding.body: Then take one slow breath: in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4.
